verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas provides general project versioning via Checkpoints (snapshot/rollback) and Editor undo/redo history, and the Editor MCP server lets AI assistants modify project data with viewport verification, but there is no dedicated mechanism to version, review, or roll back AI-driven 'automations' specifically (e.g., an audit trail of agent actions or diff/review UI for AI changes) — it relies on the same generic checkpoint/undo system used for manual edits. Missing for 10: dedicated audit/review log of AI agent actions, automation-specific versioning distinct from manual scene edits, independent evidence that rollback works reliably for AI-made changes.
